name: Guggenheim Baseball Management
verdict: Owned by Guggenheim Baseball Management. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: MLB.com (2012) names Guggenheim Baseball Management as the buyer of the Dodgers, with Mark Walter (CEO of Guggenheim Partners) as controlling partner and investors Peter Guber, Todd Boehly and Bobby Patton in the group; no state or state fund is named among the owners. No human-rights finding against Guggenheim found.
